comparison.objective: Set a telescoping gauge to a bore diameter and leave it locked on its stand; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Sweep a spring gauge through a bore, preserve wall-defined span, lock it, and extract without skew versus fine collar adjustment and hex relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Gauge span within 0.10 mm and released on its stand; candidate requires repeatable physical stopping behavior and retained collar angle.
comparison.reason: Both preserve an adjusted setting, but bore transfer measurement and dynamic damping are materially different abilities.
